description: The New Zealand benefit unit (engine Family entity): an adult, their co-resident partner, and their dependent children; every other adult forms their own unit. An adult for unit construction is any person excluded from the declared dependent-child rule, including a financially independent young person or an independent teen parent. The unit id family.family_id and membership person.person_family_id are structural graph columns (microcosm.graph.executor._structural_columns, executor.py:638-645); a non-structural node cannot own either (executor.py:1549-1554). family.family_household_id is the ordinary family column linking each unit to its household. The shared transport CREATE kernel (G4/G5a; transport/population_kernels.py:208-232) builds units from donor concept pointers under this spec. Family weights are inherited from the household through the Frame.
status: settled by the NZ hub on 2026-10-12 under G8 method addendum B8 (MC7)

source_household_lineage.rule: Each unit inherits its household's exact original-source key. The donor reader scopes raw source_household_id by source_year, merging support clones across channels; no row-order or support-row-id fallback is permitted.

composition.rule: each person who is not a dependent child anchors exactly one unit unless they join a partner's unit
a co-resident partner (partner_person_id, a symmetric pointer) joins the adult's unit; partners always share a unit

A dependent child joins the unit of its co-resident parent parent_1_person_id; if that parent is itself dependent, follow the parent chain to that parent's unit. A lone co-resident parent is always parent 1 (concepts.py:900-907), so parent_2_person_id never chooses the unit.
every other adult in the household, including boarders and flatmates, forms their own unit

dependent_child.basis: Social Security Act 2018, Schedule 2, as at 1 April 2026: child (LMS6902), dependent child (LMS7234), single (DLM6784713), and in a relationship (DLM6784537). The statutory definition requires a single person below the age limit and excludes financially independent persons in the declared young-person age range.

financial_independence.basis: Social Security Act 2018, Schedule 2, financially independent (DLM6784504, limb a) and full employment (DLM6784514, limbs a and b), as at 1 April 2026; G8 method addendum B8. The test applies only while below age_limit_years.
financial_independence.concept_evidence: concepts.py:1069-1083 declares usual weekly hours across all jobs and self-employment in worked weeks in the donor reference year, with transport CARRY. adapters/policyengine_us_concepts.py:352-362 maps weekly_hours_worked_before_lsr through Identity to this concept; transport.py:843-849 decodes the donor through that mapping. docs/concept-coverage/policyengine-us.md:31 records the same binding.
financial_independence.approximation: The donor usual rate in worked weeks is used for the statutory average weekly employment test; employment contracts and the averaging interval are not observed.

dependent_child.rulespec_encoding: The executable thresholds and placement decisions are declared in this country spec and read by the shared CREATE kernel. A future RuleSpec encoding of the Schedule 2 definitions can replace this block after its equivalence is reviewed.

child_without_coresident_parent.status: settled by the NZ hub on 2026-10-12, G8 method addendum B8
child_without_coresident_parent.rule: A dependent child with no co-resident parent joins the household reference person's unit. Refuse if the reference person is themselves a dependent child.

refusals: a unit whose members span two households
a parent or partner pointer to a person outside the household
a dependent child in a household with no adult
placement of a child without a co-resident parent with a reference person who is themselves a dependent child
invariants: every person is in exactly one unit
every unit has at least one adult
every dependent child shares a unit with a parent or the reference person
sum of family weights equals the sum over households of household weight times units in the household

unit_attributes.note: Unit attributes the planned unit-attributes node (transport.unit_attributes@1, package G5a) is to emit on the family entity, for the reg 17/18 bridge and the group encode to read. The bridge's adults_in_couple multiplier (as_rate_bridge.json) is not declared here yet; the bridge kernels (package G7) are to settle it.

columns.family.family_type: category of the MC7 unit: single, couple, sole parent, couple with children
columns.family.n_dependent_children: count of dependent children in the unit
columns.family.is_sole_parent: single adult with at least one dependent child
columns.family.is_partnered: the unit contains a partnered couple
columns.family.is_single: the unit has one adult (not family.is_partnered)
columns.family.youngest_dependent_child_age: age of the youngest dependent child; 0 when there is none

teen_parent.at_or_above_parent_independence_min_age: A person below age_limit_years with a co-resident child of their own forms their own unit with that child once at or above parent_independence_min_age.
teen_parent.below_parent_independence_min_age: A younger parent remains dependent under the other declared tests in their own parent's unit; their child joins that same unit. If the younger parent has no co-resident parent, the declared reference-person placement applies.
teen_parent.basis: Settled by the NZ hub on 2026-10-12, G8 method addendum B8. Young Parent Payment is a main benefit; Schedule 2 financially independent (DLM6784504, limb d) excludes its recipient from child. Unit construction infers the older teen-parent exclusion from the co-resident parent pointer before the receipt layer runs; receipt is not observed or assigned by this rule.

non_partnered_coparents.rule: The dependent child joins parent 1's unit when its two co-resident parents are not partners.
non_partnered_coparents.basis: Settled by the NZ hub on 2026-10-12, G8 method addendum B8; preserves the declared first-parent placement.

unobserved_statutory_limbs.omission: Student-allowance basic grants and independent-circumstances grants are not observable in the transported donor; this exclusion is not applied.
Payments from analogous Government-assisted schemes are not observable in the transported donor; this exclusion is not applied.

Main-benefit receipt is assigned after unit construction and does not otherwise exclude a young person. The declared teen-parent branch is the disclosed exception, inferred from co-resident child pointers before receipt assignment.
An award, agreement, or contract deeming employment full time at fewer hours is not observable; this exclusion is not applied.
Orphan's benefit and unsupported child's benefit receipt are not identifiable in the donor. These children remain dependent in the unit they join; the statutory exclusion is not applied.

unobserved_statutory_limbs.definition: dependent child (LMS7234, limbs a(i), a(ii), and a(iii))
unobserved_statutory_limbs.omission: Primary responsibility, maintenance and financial dependency are represented by household and parent placement rather than observed care or support. Oranga Tamariki payments and placements, and a young parent payment to a caregiver who is not the child's parent or step-parent, are not identifiable; their statutory distinctions are not applied.

unobserved_statutory_limbs.definition: single (DLM6784713) and in a relationship (DLM6784537), as used in child (LMS6902); section 8 (DLM6783126)
unobserved_statutory_limbs.omission: Statutory single status is approximated by the co-resident partner pointer (partner_person_id). A married, civil-union or de facto young person whose spouse or partner does not live in the household is treated as single and can be placed as a dependent child. Legal marital status is not recovered by the donor decoder, and MSD determinations under section 8 that a person is or is not single are not observable; neither is applied.

unit_construction_diagnostics.hours_independent_children: Count of otherwise dependent candidates at or above financial_independence.min_age and below age_limit_years excluded by min_usual_weekly_hours.
unit_construction_diagnostics.independent_teen_parents: Count of persons below age_limit_years with a co-resident child, at or above parent_independence_min_age, excluded from dependency by the parent rule.
unit_construction_diagnostics.dependent_teen_parents: Count of persons with a co-resident child below parent_independence_min_age who remain dependent under the declared rules.
unit_construction_diagnostics.non_partnered_coparent_households: Count of distinct households containing a dependent child with two co-resident parents who are not partners; count a household once even when several children qualify.
unit_construction_diagnostics.children_with_reference_person: Count of dependent children with no co-resident parent placed in the household reference person's unit.
